title: What's New: Opening Visual Studio Code from the Web Client (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Feature recap - opening Visual Studio Code from the web client
Extension source code and prior releases
Extension dependencies and downloading symbols demo

features.name: Generate launch configurations
features.description: Ability to generate launch configurations that match the environment directly from Help and Support and Extension Management pages, automatically creating or updating configurations without manual parameter editing.
caveats: Sandbox-specific features (publish and attach debugger) are only available for sandbox environments
Download symbols and snapshot debug are available for both sandbox and production

features.name: Extension dependencies formatting
features.description: Ability to select extensions in Extension Management and format them as dependencies that can be copied and shared across projects using Show and Copy functionality.

features.name: Download dependencies to VS Code
features.description: Ability to download selected extension dependencies directly to a VS Code project with a single click, making symbols available immediately for coding against extensions.

features.name: Symbol search in VS Code
features.description: Ability to search for and navigate to symbols from dependencies using Control+T (Go to Symbol) in VS Code, showing available tables, pages and other objects from apps and Microsoft dependencies.
caveats: Works only for symbols where source code is available

features.name: Copilot integration with symbol search
features.description: Ability to provide Copilot with symbol context by using special keyword to search for symbols, allowing Copilot to give more informed answers about table structures and fields without access to entire source code.
